_about: B714 acceptance (6) (b), critic finding 1: the sha256 of each pre-B714 chunk's render with ONE module on, as a build of main before B714 (3159a196, engine 6cd98b5, the pins it had) plays it: the chunk loaded, a four-note chord held for 1.5 s, 44.1 kHz, blocks of 512, the float output interleaved (smoke.cpp migrated_render). smoke holds the new build's render to these only on the engine commit they were made on; on another it prints NOT RUN. Measured 2026-11-26 by `preview-smoke --migration <new clap> <main clap>`, which also reads the two renders against each other directly: bit-identical, max |difference| 0. The chunk with both modules on is not here: before B714 the chain rounded to float between the two modules and the rack keeps double, so it is measured, never held (max |difference| 1.97440386e-07, RMS 3.5810403e-08 over 132300 samples, peak 0.174367).
